factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report: 'The Company does not have any plan to change or start a new business activity next year and will continue to sell of land plots the Company owns.'

factual_claims.claim: Total assets decreased to €1,804,656 from €1,873,680, mainly reflecting the reduction in cash from €370,856 to €227,911.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Condensed statement of financial position shows total assets of €1,804,656 as at 31.12.2025 vs €1,873,680 as at 31.12.2024; cash of €227,911 vs €370,856.

factual_claims.claim: Operating activities used €142,945 of cash in 2025, compared with €194,723 generated in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Condensed cash flow statement shows cash flows from operating activities of €-142,945 for 12M 2025 vs €194,723 for 12M 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Total liabilities increased to €49,389 from €18,906, while equity declined to €1,755,267 from €1,854,774 following the annual loss.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Condensed statement of financial position shows total liabilities of €49,389 as at 31.12.2025 vs €18,906 as at 31.12.2024; total equity of €1,755,267 vs €1,854,774. Condensed statement of changes in equity shows equity decrease due to net loss.

factual_claims.claim: Return on assets changed from 8.93% to -5.51%, return on equity from 9.03% to -5.67%, and the debt ratio from 1.01% to 2.74%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial ratios table in management report provides: ROA 8.93% (2024) vs -5.51% (2025); ROE 9.03% (2024) vs -5.67% (2025); debt ratio 1.01% (2024) vs 2.74% (2025).

factual_claims.claim: The number of shares remained unchanged at 4,499,061.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 5 and share table show number of shares at 4,499,061 as at 31.12.2025 and 31.12.2024.

factual_claims.claim: Earnings per share fell from €0.03721 to -€0.02212, while the year-end share price increased modestly from €0.620 to €0.634.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 7 provides basic EPS of €-0.02212 for 2025 vs €0.03721 for 2024; closing share price of €0.634 for 2025 vs €0.620 for 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The company’s 2025 interim report was unaudited.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Board's declaration states: 'The Management Board confirms the correctness and completeness of the unaudited interim report... This interim report has not been audited.'
